message.content: {"note_claim": "NATO provides aid to Ukraine but is not directly engaged in combat with Russia and has no troops deployed in Ukraine.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Enforcing a no-fly zone or deploying combat troops to Ukraine would bring NATO forces into direct conflict with Russia.", "reason": "The NATO page describes extensive aid to Ukraine and explains that NATO is not sending troops, since doing so would cause direct conflict with Russia, which backs the note's NATO-related claims (though not the troop figures)."}

parsed.note_claim: NATO provides aid to Ukraine but is not directly engaged in combat with Russia and has no troops deployed in Ukraine.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Enforcing a no-fly zone or deploying combat troops to Ukraine would bring NATO forces into direct conflict with Russia.
parsed.reason: The NATO page describes extensive aid to Ukraine and explains that NATO is not sending troops, since doing so would cause direct conflict with Russia, which backs the note's NATO-related claims (though not the troop figures).
